fusions.name: Snatched Mid-Cast
fusions.desc: Silences one enemy within 6 tiles for 3 seconds and deals 9 damage, taking its next action away and stunning it for 0.8 seconds.

fusions.name: Quick-Palmed Darts
fusions.desc: Flicks a palmed dart at a target up to 6 tiles away, which deals 7 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach. Holds 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Caught and Returned
fusions.desc: For 5 seconds, 30% of the damage you take is caught and dealt back to whoever dealt it, and you move 20% faster.

fusions.name: By the Wrist
fusions.desc: When you strike an enemy, your next strike has 15% more critical hit chance, and the enemy moves 15% slower for 2 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.
